   - For A: the formatting assertions must keep running fast — stub/stief the stress
     annotation dependency so no model loads. Only fall back to @pytest.mark.slow if the
     test genuinely asserts stress-annotation OUTPUT (then say so and keep a fast
     formatting-only sibling).
   - For B: the production code sleeps between retry attempts — find the sleep seam
     (visible_sleep / time.sleep call site) and make it injectable, then inject a no-op
     in the tests. Do NOT mark these slow — they guard required dispatch behavior. The
     assertions (attempt counts, logged timeouts, per-call cap honored) must stay
     exactly as strong: mutation-check by reverting your injection and confirming the
     test still fails when the ladder logic is broken.

## Summary of Changes

### 1. Issue #6999: Stub Stress Annotation in Slovnyk Markdown Formatting Unit Test
- **Location**: [`tests/test_enrich.py::TestSlovnyk::test_build_slovnyk_markdown_formatting`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6999-wallclock/tests/test_enrich.py#L62-L87)
- **Problem**: Calling `build_slovnyk_markdown()` invoked `_stress_word()` which loaded the full Stanza NLP model (~20.6s in CI / 3.8s warm) for pure markdown table formatting assertions that stripped combining accents anyway.
- **Fix**: Injected a `monkeypatch` fixture in `test_build_slovnyk_markdown_formatting` to stub `pipeline.stress_annotator.annotate_stress` with a fast word-level mapping (`літера` -> `лі́тера`). Model loading tests remain properly isolated in `@pytest.mark.slow` tests in `tests/test_stress_annotation.py`.

### 2. Issue #7000: Injectable Retry Backoffs and Pacing in `dispatch_agent`
- **Locations**:
  - [`scripts/build/dispatch.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6999-wallclock/scripts/build/dispatch.py#L65-L75)
  - [`tests/test_dispatch.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6999-wallclock/tests/test_dispatch.py#L497-L565)
- **Problem**: Subprocess retry attempts in `test_timeout_logged` and `test_gemini_dispatch_honors_custom_per_call_cap` incurred real 10s `visible_sleep` retry backoffs (2x10s in `test_timeout_logged`, 1x10s in custom cap) plus 3s `_pace_gemini_calls()` sleeps, consuming >35s of wall-clock time in required fast-path tests.
- **Fix**: Added optional `sleep_fn` parameter to [`dispatch_agent()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6999-wallclock/scripts/build/dispatch.py#L407-L484), [`_dispatch_via_runtime()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6999-wallclock/scripts/build/dispatch.py#L619-L635), and [`_pace_gemini_calls()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6999-wallclock/scripts/build/dispatch.py#L65-L75). Injected no-op tracking sleepers in tests and asserted that backoff sleep calls (`[10, 10]` and `[10]`) were requested without blocking wall clock.
